entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
Certainly, I can assist with that. Could you please provide me with your order number?
It's VF982-15B. For a VeloBand Pulse.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Look, I already tried to do this online last week. Your whole system was down. I kept getting a website error and couldn't print the return label.
I see. So you're just looking to process a standard return?
Yes. I even took a screenshot of the error because I knew this would be a problem.
I understand. Let me just check the policy for you... One moment.
Okay, thank you for waiting. I see here that the item was delivered on December 15th. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the timeframe.

Yes, it's no problem at all. I have just initiated the return for you. I've sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. You'll see a full refund processed once our warehouse receives it.
Whatever. As long as it's handled.
It is. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright then. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
